data.desc: Valens Semiconductor (NYSE: VLN) is a leading provider of high-performance connectivity chipsets, enabling reliable, high-bandwidth, long-reach video transmission across the world's most demanding applications. Valens' chipsets are integrated into countless devices from leading customers, powering state-of-the-art audio-video installations, next-generation videoconferencing, Advanced Driver Assistance Systems (ADAS) and autonomous driving. Valens is a pioneer in connectivity technologies and a key contributor to leading industry standards, including HDBaseT and MIPI A-PHY. For more information, visit www.valens.
